@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+package info
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"net/http"
+)
+
+// Flipt contains information about the running Flipt binary.
+type Flipt struct {
+	Version         string `json:"version,omitempty"`
+	LatestVersion   string `json:"latestVersion,omitempty"`
+	Commit          string `json:"commit,omitempty"`
+	BuildDate       string `json:"buildDate,omitempty"`
+	GoVersion       string `json:"goVersion,omitempty"`
+	UpdateAvailable bool   `json:"updateAvailable"`
+	IsRelease       bool   `json:"isRelease"`
+}
+
+// ServeHTTP writes the running Flipt information as JSON.
+func (i Flipt) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
+	out, err := json.Marshal(i)
+	if err != nil {
+		http.Error(w, http.StatusText(http.StatusInternalServerError), http.StatusInternalServerError)
+		return
+	}
+
+	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
+	if _, err := w.Write(out); err != nil {
+		// Headers may already have been sent, so only a best-effort status is possible.
+		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusInternalServerError)
+	}
+}

+package info
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"errors"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestFliptServeHTTP(t *testing.T) {
+	flipt := Flipt{Version: "1.2.3", IsRelease: true}
+	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
+	flipt.ServeHTTP(w, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/meta/info", nil))
+	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, w.Code)
+	assert.Equal(t, "application/json", w.Header().Get("Content-Type"))
+	var body Flipt
+	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(w.Body.Bytes(), &body))
+	assert.Equal(t, flipt, body)
+}
+
+type failingWriter struct {
+	header http.Header
+	status int
+}
+
+func (w *failingWriter) Header() http.Header       { return w.header }
+func (w *failingWriter) Write([]byte) (int, error) { return 0, errors.New("write failed") }
+func (w *failingWriter) WriteHeader(status int)    { w.status = status }
+
+func TestFliptServeHTTPWriteFailure(t *testing.T) {
+	w := &failingWriter{header: make(http.Header)}
+	Flipt{}.ServeHTTP(w, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/meta/info", nil))
+	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusInternalServerError, w.status)
+}
diff --git a/telemetry/telemetry.go b/telemetry/telemetry.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..cef2b1d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/telemetry/telemetry.go
@@ -0,0 +1,258 @@
+// Package telemetry reports anonymous information about a running Flipt host.
+package telemetry
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"net/http"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sync"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/gofrs/uuid"
+	"github.com/markphelps/flipt/config"
+	"github.com/sirupsen/logrus"
+)
+
+const (
+	schemaVersion = "1.0"
+	stateFileName = "telemetry.json"
+	pingInterval  = 4 * time.Hour
+	// Flipt's anonymous telemetry collection endpoint.
+	defaultEndpoint = "https://telemetry.flipt.io/v1/track"
+)
+
+// FliptVersion is set by the command at startup to the running binary's version.
+var FliptVersion = "dev"
+
+type state struct {
+	Version       string `json:"version"`
+	UUID          string `json:"uuid"`
+	LastTimestamp string `json:"lastTimestamp"`
+}
+
+// Reporter sends a periodic ping and keeps the host's anonymous ID on disk.
+type Reporter struct {
+	logger   logrus.FieldLogger
+	client   *http.Client
+	endpoint string
+	path     string
+	version  string
+	state    state
+	mu       sync.Mutex
+	start    sync.Once
+}
+
+// NewReporter initializes the host's telemetry state. Disabled telemetry never
+// touches the state directory. A non-directory state path disables reporting.
+func NewReporter(cfg *config.Config, logger logrus.FieldLogger) (*Reporter, error) {
+	if cfg == nil || !cfg.Meta.TelemetryEnabled {
+		return nil, nil
+	}
+	if logger == nil {
+		logger = logrus.StandardLogger()
+	}
+
+	dir := cfg.Meta.StateDirectory
+	if dir == "" {
+		var err error
+		dir, err = os.UserConfigDir()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, logError(logger, fmt.Errorf("finding telemetry state directory: %w", err))
+		}
+	}
+
+	if fi, err := os.Stat(dir); err == nil {
+		if !fi.IsDir() {
+			logger.Warnf("telemetry disabled: state path %q is not a directory", dir)
+			return nil, nil
+		}
+	} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
+		return nil, logError(logger, fmt.Errorf("checking telemetry state directory: %w", err))
+	}
+
+	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0700); err != nil {
+		return nil, logError(logger, fmt.Errorf("creating telemetry state directory: %w", err))
+	}
+
+	r := &Reporter{
+		logger:   logger,
+		client:   &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second},
+		endpoint: defaultEndpoint,
+		path:     filepath.Join(dir, stateFileName),
+		version:  FliptVersion,
+	}
+	if err := r.loadState(); err != nil {
+		return nil, logError(logger, err)
+	}
+	return r, nil
+}
+
+func (r *Reporter) loadState() error {
+	data, err := os.ReadFile(r.path)
+	if err != nil && !os.IsNotExist(err) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("reading telemetry state: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	needsSave := os.IsNotExist(err)
+	if !needsSave {
+		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &r.state); err != nil {
+			r.logger.Warnf("invalid telemetry state, creating a new anonymous ID: %v", err)
+			r.state = state{}
+			needsSave = true
+		}
+	}
+
+	if _, err := uuid.FromString(r.state.UUID); err != nil {
+		if !needsSave {
+			r.logger.Warn("invalid telemetry UUID, creating a new anonymous ID")
+		}
+		id, err := uuid.NewV4()
+		if err != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("generating telemetry ID: %w", err)
+		}
+		r.state.UUID = id.String()
+		needsSave = true
+	}
+	if r.state.Version != schemaVersion {
+		r.state.Version = schemaVersion
+		needsSave = true
+	}
+	if _, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, r.state.LastTimestamp); err != nil {
+		if !needsSave {
+			r.logger.Warn("invalid telemetry timestamp, resetting report time")
+		}
+		r.state.LastTimestamp = time.Time{}.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
+		needsSave = true
+	}
+	if needsSave {
+		if err := writeState(r.path, r.state); err != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("writing telemetry state: %w", err)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func writeState(path string, s state) error {
+	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(s, "", "  ")
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	data = append(data, '\n')
+
+	file, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".telemetry-*.json")
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	defer os.Remove(file.Name())
+	if _, err := file.Write(data); err != nil {
+		_ = file.Close()
+		return err
+	}
+	if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	return os.Rename(file.Name(), path)
+}
+
+// Start schedules reports in the background until ctx is canceled. The first
+// report is due immediately for a host that has never reported successfully.
+func (r *Reporter) Start(ctx context.Context) {
+	if r == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	r.start.Do(func() {
+		go r.loop(ctx)
+	})
+}
+
+func (r *Reporter) loop(ctx context.Context) {
+	var retryAfter time.Time
+	for {
+		r.mu.Lock()
+		last, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, r.state.LastTimestamp)
+		r.mu.Unlock()
+		due := last.Add(pingInterval)
+		if due.Before(retryAfter) {
+			due = retryAfter
+		}
+		wait := time.Until(due)
+		if wait < 0 {
+			wait = 0
+		}
+		timer := time.NewTimer(wait)
+		select {
+		case <-ctx.Done():
+			timer.Stop()
+			return
+		case <-timer.C:
+		}
+		if ctx.Err() != nil {
+			return
+		}
+		_ = r.Report(ctx) // Report logs errors; the next attempt stays four hours away.
+		retryAfter = time.Now().Add(pingInterval)
+	}
+}
+
+// Report sends a single anonymous ping and records its successful delivery.
+func (r *Reporter) Report(ctx context.Context) error {
+	if r == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	r.mu.Lock()
+	defer r.mu.Unlock()
+
+	event := struct {
+		AnonymousId string `json:"anonymousId"`
+		Event       string `json:"event"`
+		Properties  struct {
+			UUID         string `json:"uuid"`
+			Version      string `json:"version"`
+			FliptVersion string `json:"flipt.version"`
+		} `json:"properties"`
+		Context struct {
+			IP string `json:"ip"`
+		} `json:"context"`
+	}{
+		AnonymousId: r.state.UUID,
+		Event:       "flipt.ping",
+	}
+	event.Properties.UUID = r.state.UUID
+	event.Properties.Version = r.state.Version
+	event.Properties.FliptVersion = r.version
+	// Segment-compatible receivers must not infer and store the source IP.
+	event.Context.IP = "0.0.0.0"
+
+	body, err := json.Marshal(event)
+	if err != nil {
+		return logError(r.logger, fmt.Errorf("encoding telemetry event: %w", err))
+	}
+	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, r.endpoint, bytes.NewReader(body))
+	if err != nil {
+		return logError(r.logger, fmt.Errorf("creating telemetry request: %w", err))
+	}
+	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
+	resp, err := r.client.Do(req)
+	if err != nil {
+		return logError(r.logger, fmt.Errorf("sending telemetry: %w", err))
+	}
+	defer resp.Body.Close()
+	if resp.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || resp.StatusCode >= http.StatusMultipleChoices {
+		return logError(r.logger, fmt.Errorf("sending telemetry: status %s", resp.Status))
+	}
+
+	r.state.LastTimestamp = time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
+	if err := writeState(r.path, r.state); err != nil {
+		return logError(r.logger, fmt.Errorf("writing telemetry state: %w", err))
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func logError(logger logrus.FieldLogger, err error) error {
+	logger.Warn(err)
+	return err
+}

+package telemetry
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"io"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"runtime"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/gofrs/uuid"
+	"github.com/markphelps/flipt/config"
+	"github.com/sirupsen/logrus"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func testLogger() *logrus.Logger {
+	logger := logrus.New()
+	logger.SetOutput(io.Discard)
+	return logger
+}
+
+func readState(t *testing.T, path string) state {
+	t.Helper()
+	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	var s state
+	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(data, &s))
+	return s
+}
+
+func TestNewReporterState(t *testing.T) {
+	dir := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "state")
+	cfg := config.Default()
+	cfg.Meta.StateDirectory = dir
+
+	r, err := NewReporter(cfg, testLogger())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NotNil(t, r)
+	assert.Equal(t, filepath.Join(dir, "telemetry.json"), r.path)
+	first := readState(t, r.path)
+	assert.Equal(t, schemaVersion, first.Version)
+	_, err = uuid.FromString(first.UUID)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	_, err = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, first.LastTimestamp)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	// A malformed ID is replaced once, then stays stable across restarts.
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(r.path, []byte(`{"version":"old","uuid":"bad","lastTimestamp":"bad"}`), 0600))
+	r, err = NewReporter(cfg, testLogger())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	second := readState(t, r.path)
+	_, err = uuid.FromString(second.UUID)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.NotEqual(t, first.UUID, second.UUID)
+	assert.Equal(t, schemaVersion, second.Version)
+	_, err = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, second.LastTimestamp)
+	require.NoError(t, err)

+func TestReport(t *testing.T) {
+	cfg := config.Default()
+	cfg.Meta.StateDirectory = t.TempDir()
+	previousVersion := FliptVersion
+	FliptVersion = "1.2.3"
+	defer func() { FliptVersion = previousVersion }()
+	r, err := NewReporter(cfg, testLogger())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	before := readState(t, r.path)
+	requestBody := make(chan []byte, 1)
+	srv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
+		assert.Equal(t, http.MethodPost, req.Method)
+		assert.Equal(t, "application/json", req.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
+		body, _ := io.ReadAll(req.Body)
+		requestBody <- body
+		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusAccepted)
+	}))
+	defer srv.Close()
+	r.endpoint = srv.URL
+	r.client = srv.Client()
+
+	require.NoError(t, r.Report(context.Background()))
+	var event struct {
+		AnonymousID string `json:"anonymousId"`
+		Event       string `json:"event"`
+		Properties  struct {
+			UUID         string `json:"uuid"`
+			Version      string `json:"version"`
+			FliptVersion string `json:"flipt.version"`
+		} `json:"properties"`
+		Context struct {
+			IP string `json:"ip"`
+		} `json:"context"`
+	}
+	body := <-requestBody
+	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(body, &event))
+	assert.Equal(t, "flipt.ping", event.Event)
+	assert.Equal(t, before.UUID, event.AnonymousID)
+	assert.Equal(t, before.UUID, event.Properties.UUID)
+	assert.Equal(t, schemaVersion, event.Properties.Version)
+	assert.Equal(t, "1.2.3", event.Properties.FliptVersion)
+	assert.Equal(t, "0.0.0.0", event.Context.IP)
+	assert.NotContains(t, string(body), "hostname")
+
+	after := readState(t, r.path)
+	assert.Equal(t, before.UUID, after.UUID)
+	assert.NotEqual(t, before.LastTimestamp, after.LastTimestamp)
+	reported, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, after.LastTimestamp)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.WithinDuration(t, time.Now(), reported, 2*time.Second)
+}

+func TestStartRespectsCancellation(t *testing.T) {
+	cfg := config.Default()
+	cfg.Meta.StateDirectory = t.TempDir()
+	r, err := NewReporter(cfg, testLogger())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	requests := make(chan struct{}, 1)
+	canceled := make(chan struct{})
+	release := make(chan struct{})
+	srv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
+		_, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, req.Body)
+		requests <- struct{}{}
+		select {
+		case <-req.Context().Done():
+			close(canceled)
+		case <-release:
+		}
+	}))
+	defer func() {
+		close(release)
+		srv.Close()
+	}()
+	r.endpoint = srv.URL
+	r.client = srv.Client()
+
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+	r.Start(ctx)
+	select {
+	case <-requests:
+	case <-time.After(2 * time.Second):
+		t.Fatal("initial telemetry report was not sent")
+	}
+	cancel()
+	select {
+	case <-canceled:
+	case <-time.After(2 * time.Second):
+		t.Fatal("telemetry request did not stop after cancellation")
+	}
+}
